scenarios.title: Completed delivery (split implementation & monitoring atoms) vs planned Q4 RFC work (split sharding & benchmark atoms, observation-time scoped)

scenarios.rationale: claim-06-1 splits endpoint implementation and production monitoring integration into 2 DIRECT atoms; claim-06-2 splits sharding completion and benchmark completion into 2 CONTRADICTED atoms scoped to observation time.

scenarios.title: Negation context (reverted rollout KEPT; split negated production deployment & negated 30% cost savings)

scenarios.rationale: Explicit negations in src07 independently refute production deployment (fact-07-2 -> atom-07-2) and 30% compute cost savings (fact-07-3 -> atom-07-3) while supporting rollback claim-07-1.

scenarios.title: Team achievement vs individual contribution (KEPT claim-08-1; split solo contradiction, unsupported 'from scratch', and team-only 22->8m metric)

scenarios.rationale: claim-08-1 remains DIRECT-supported for individual cache layer work; claim-08-2 separates solo rebuild attribution (CONTRADICTS 6-engineer team fact-08-1), 'from scratch' (UNSUPPORTED), and 22->8m team outcome (CONTEXT-only).

scenarios.title: Staging/test benchmark (KEPT claim-09-1) vs unstarted production deployment & staging-only metric split (claim-09-2)
review_required_items: Confirm environment-scope split on claim-09-2: unstarted production deployment (CONTRADICTED) vs production p95 metric (CONTEXT-only from staging)
scenarios.rationale: claim-09-1 accurately describes the local staging sandbox benchmark; claim-09-2 separates unstarted production deployment (CONTRADICTS fact-09-2) from production p95 improvement (CONTEXT-only from staging fact-09-1).

scenarios.title: Unverified causation and fabricated metric in a 3-atom partial claim

scenarios.rationale: Only 1 of 3 required atoms is DIRECT-supported; atom-10-2 is CONTEXT-only and atom-10-3 has 0 supports -> cannot be SOURCE_VERIFIED.

scenarios.title: Identity ambiguity (unmapped homonym 'Alex') vs verified account author
review_required_items: Confirm identity resolution threshold before allowing SOURCE_VERIFIED
scenarios.rationale: Unmapped 'Alex' shared by two team members blocks automatic SOURCE_VERIFIED on claim-11-1.

scenarios.title: User edit creates new version requiring re-verification (claim-12-1 split global scope & 60% metric without global-falsity inference; claim-12-2 KEPT)
review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm product state transition when minor paraphrase v2 (claim-12-2) completes re-verification against fact-12-1
Confirm claim-12-1 v2 re-verification fails on both global tuning scope (atom-12-1) and global 60% metric (atom-12-3) without inferring 60% is false in every measurement scope
scenarios.rationale: User edits increment claim_version to v2 and forbid v1 auto-promotion; claim-12-1 splits global tuning and global 60% latency claims which fail v2 re-verification against checkout-only 25% evidence without over-inferring universal falsity.
